collision_examples: PE = Pemko (mfr) in nearly every set and also appears inside catalog strings (PE8806, PE8876) and in 'PE Project 96050.00' footer. NO = Norton (mfr, e.g. 'CA1601 P 689 NO'). AL appears as a finish ('PV-ENDLOAD AL GS', aluminum), as a catalog prefix ('AL 5CH 70 PE8876-24v NEMW', alarm), and in notes ('Omit Door Closer at AL Sleeping Room Doors', assisted living). 'Surface Closer DA' -- DA is part of the description, followed by '351 O EN SA' where EN is the finish. Rows with no finish (blank) put PE/MK/SU directly after catalog, so x-position (finish vs mfr column) is the only reliable discriminator. Numeric catalog that looks like a finish: Viewer row '1 Viewer | 626 | DCRM | RO' -- 626 is the catalog number (catalog column) and DCRM the finish; likewise '1 Viewer 627 BLK RO'.
quirks: Qty and description share the left cell ('3 Hinge, Full Mortise'); no unit column; qty can be '*' (MISC Hub) or blank (vendor sets).
Catalog column mostly blue hyperlink text; catalog may wrap to 2 lines and contains template junk 'DRT-275BD-T DR-OtherAAPrep_FinSet1' (p689).
Orange lightning-bolt icon after mfr on electrified items.
Many blank finish cells (gasketing, sweeps, thresholds, harnesses).
Long multi-line Notes / Operational Narrative blocks between sets.
Section uses runaway paragraph lettering (FFFFF., JJJJJ.) in Part 3 text before the sets.

Footer clutter: 'LIVELLE MULHOLLAND Woodland Hills, CA PE Project 96050.00 DOOR HARDWARE 08 71 00 - NN BID SET - December 12, 2025' plus blue stamp 'LIVELLE - EXHIBIT B - BID SET_REV1 SPECS 12-12-2025 SL RECEIVED 01-16-2026'.
Same consultant template (centered 'Set: N.N', blue catalog) as USI Radnet book.
Vol2/3/4 of the same project have no hardware sets (see _negatives_e.json).
notes_for_extractor: Finish vs mfr must be decided by column x-position because finish is frequently blank and 2-letter mfr codes (PE, NO, SA) collide with catalog fragments and notes. Sets break across pages mid-component-list and mid-narrative, and the vendor placeholder sets (147-151, mfr '00') and MISC set need special handling.
